chunks: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Do I offer the salutation (taslim) in the two rak'ahs of al-Witr?' He said: 'If you wish, you may offer the salutation, and if you wish, you may not offer the salutation.'

key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الْوَتْرِ: the two rak'ahs of Witr prayer

ai.seo_question: Is it obligatory to say taslim after the two rak'ahs of Witr prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Sahih al-Tusi highlights the juristic flexibility (ikhtiyar) in the Witr prayer, reflecting the Shia view that Witr is a confirmed Sunnah rather than a strict obligation requiring a fixed conclusion. The Imam’s permission to either conclude with taslim or remain in prayer for additional recitation underscores the adaptability of night prayers to the worshipper’s capacity and devotion.
